Adds a kube.io "Magnifying Glass" liquid-glass"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" refraction effect to the input card of the DSH Web GUI:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- 官方位移图/高光图/放大图，端头等比缩放贴合四角，中段平铺补线；Canvas 预合成，滤镜内约 11 原语
- Official displacement / specular / magnify"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ing maps, corners scaled to fit, edges tiled; maps are pre-composited on canvas, about eleven filter"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" primitives in total
- 按压动画：原版 9 弹簧系统逐参数复刻（rAF 积分，transform/阴影/滤镜缩放全耦合）
- Press animation faithfully"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" rebuilt from the original nine-spring system (rAF-integrated, with transform, shadow and filter sca"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"le all coupled)
- 点击像素增艳：按住时指针附近的背景会变浓、变亮（有范围，不是盖一层白；设置里可关），动画速度可调
- Click pixel boost: while pressi"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ng, the backdrop near the pointer grows richer and brighter (a bounded area, not a white overlay; sw"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"itchable in settings), with an animation-speed slider
- 仅 Chromium 系浏览器可见折射
- Refraction is visible "},{"id":"p10s8","text":"only in Chromium-based browsers"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 玻璃的层次 / Layers of the glass"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"常见的「液态玻璃」皮肤只是把背景糊掉一层：透过卡片什么都看不真切，边缘也没有任何变化。这里把玻璃拆成了五个层次，各有各的观感：
Most so-called "liquid glass" skins "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"simply blur whatever sits behind the card: everything behind turns into mush and the edge does nothi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ng optical. Here the glass is split into five layers, each with its own look:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| 层 Layer | 观感 What you see |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| 放大 Magnify | 贴近边缘的背景被微微放大，像隔着玻璃加厚的棱边看东西
The background right inside the rim is slightly magnified,"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" as if seen through the thickened edge of real glass |
| 折射 Refract | 直线走到卡片边缘会弯一下、收一下，如同光线穿过有厚度的玻璃改"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"了方向
Straight lines bend and pinch inward as they reach the card's edge, the way light changes direct"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ion passing through thick glass |
| 高光 Specular | 棱线上有一道随按压流动的亮边
A bright rim along the edges that s"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"hifts while you press |
| 磨砂 Frost | 底下垫着一层雾面，托住上面三层，浓淡可调
A frosted veil underneath that carries the"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" other layers; its strength is adjustable |
| 色散 Dispersion | 折射时红、绿、蓝三个颜色通道的偏移量略有差别，棱边上留下一线细细的彩虹边（色"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"差）
The three color channels refract by slightly different amounts, leaving a thin rainbow fringe alo"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ng the edge (chromatic aberration) |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"普通磨砂是把背景「糊掉」，这里是想让背景「穿过」一块有厚度的玻璃。各层都能在设置里单独开关、调强弱。
Ordinary frost just smears the background; this t"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ries to let it pass through a piece of glass that has actual thickness. Every layer can be toggled a"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"nd tuned separately in the settings."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 两种动画 / Two animations"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**按压 Press**——按下卡片时它向外微微鼓起、阴影随之收拢，松手沿弹簧曲线荡两下回到原位；指针附近透过玻璃看到的景色会变浓、变亮，不想要可以在设置里关掉。
**Press** — pressi"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ng gently bulges the card outward while its shadow pulls in; on release it settles back with a sprin"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"gy wobble. The view through the glass grows richer and brighter around the pointer, which can be swi"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"tched off in settings."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**按住拖动 Drag-stretch**——按住不放再移动，玻璃会先跟着手走一小段，像被拽着的软胶体；同时顺着移动方向被拉长、垂直方向被压扁，速度越快形变越明显。松手后位移和形状一起弹回原状。「跟着"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"手走」的距离和「拉伸」的幅度各有滑杆可调。
**Drag-stretch** — hold and move: the glass trails your pointer for a short di"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"stance like pulled soft jelly, stretching along the motion and squashing sideways; the faster you mo"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ve, the stronger the deformation. On release, position and shape spring back together. Trail distanc"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"e and stretch amount each have their own slider."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 性能与开销 / Performance"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"这套效果很吃性能，电脑弱一点就会卡。觉得卡，先关磨砂，再关放大和折射。
This effect is heavy. On a weaker machine it will stutter. If it"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" does, switch off frost first, then magnify and refract."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"所以只做输入卡，不做整套主题——侧栏、消息列表那些大地方一铺，只会更卡。
That is why this is only the input card, not a full theme: spre"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ading the same glass over the sidebar or the message list would hitch even more."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## 安装 / Install"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"GitHub："},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"本地开发调试可从目录安装：
